deviations.rule: tools/run/accumulator_sweep_mn_k4.py `run` recomputed all 11 sampled fast 1k files at batch 5 in the scratch root and printed 11 x status pass, then failed to write its result file (relative plan path). Fixed (plan path resolved) and a CPU mode `compare` added that compares the existing repeat files with the fast files; it wrote artifacts/accumulator_sweep_mn_v1/k4/k4-round1-result-175140.json (11/11 pass, 11,000 records identical, nodes equal). Later rounds use the fixed `run`.
The K4 job is entered in logs/fast-jobs.jsonl as job k4-round1 with begin = end - (sum of per-file seconds) - 30 s (204 s); later K4 rounds likewise.
